newsitem.title: INDIA: India castorseed futures drop in post-budget trade.
newsitem.headline: India castorseed futures drop in post-budget trade.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery dropped 9.0 rupees to 1,190/1,191 per quintal on profit-taking in a special trading session held after the presentation of India's federal budget on Friday, brokers said.
The fiscal budget for 1997/98 (April/March) was presented by Finance Minister P. Chidambaram in parliament on Friday.
"We expected the budget to raise import duty on edible oils and hence we had entered into fresh deals in the pre-budget session. But no such announcement came throuh," said a broker.
He said the traders liquidated long positions in the post- budget session, resulting in selling.
In the pre-budget session, prices rose 11 rupees per quintal on fresh speculative buying, dealers said.

Groundnut oil was up by a rupee at 343/344 rupees per 10 kg amid limited activity. Sentiment was however firm on expectation that the finance minister may hike import duty on edible oil in the budget.
The present import duty on edible oil at 20 percent, however, has not been changed.
Imported palm oil was quiet at 281/282 rupees per 10 kg amid limited activity. In Rajkot spot groundnut oil moved up by 3/4 rupees at 518/519 rupees per 15 kg.
